  "name": "bt_rssi_histogram_update",

    "v6": "distinct_class_count",
    "v7": "class_mask",
    "v8": "max_bucket_sum",
    "v9": "total_rssi_sum",
    "v10": "sample",
    "v11": "raw_sample",
    "v12": "clamped_sample",
    "v13": "bucket_idx",
    "v14": "bucket_ptr",
    "v15": "bucket_sum",
    "v24": "ctx_index",
    "v25": "bucket_sums"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 0, "meaning": "max bucket index (local frame v23)"},
    {"offset": 4, "meaning": "context index (local frame v24)"},
    {"offset": 8, "meaning": "array of five RSSI bucket sums (local frame v25)"}
  ]
